rows.en: Well then, invite me again!
(Hanging out at the beach is pretty nice too, huh.)

(Today I invited Ranka-chan out
to the artificial island~)

\p-chan, you're late!
If we don't hurry, it'll get crowded!
You've just got too much energy, Ranka-chan.
But it was super fun.
(Hanging out at the beach is great, huh.)
(Ranka and I made plans to hang out today...)

(I haven't planned anything, though.
So, where should we go...)

Sorry to keep you waiting!
\p-kun!

Hey, you're early.
So, where should we go today?
Um, let me see...
Isn't there anywhere you want to go, Ranka?

Hmm~, there are just too many...
But maybe a movie... or shopping?
I see. But we don't have to pick just one, right?

Hehe!
Then let's do both!

Oh my, you two seem awfully chummy.
Off on a date, are we?
rows.notes: Michel, male; mock-polite, sneaking up on them.

rows.en: Heh, what're you panicking for? It's me.
Michel-san!
Hello, Ranka-chan.
Hello!
Don't I get a hello?

Oh, \p.
You were here too?
What a way to treat me...

That's right!
Poor \p-kun!
Wh-what is it, Michel?

I see, I see...
Well, I'm impressed, \p.
rows.notes: Michel, male (minaoshita: you went up in my estimation).

rows.en: ...Impressed by what?

Well, he may be like this,
but take good care of him, Ranka-chan.
Huh? Oh, yes!
See ya, Ranka-chan.

H-hey!
Nothing for me?!
I've got nothing to say to an idiot. Later!
I wonder what Michel was trying to say...
Uh, yeah, I wonder.
N-nothing at all!
Well, let's shake that off and get going!
Man, that was fun.

Yes!
Please invite me again if you'd like!!

Of course!
Well then, shall we head home?
(We got interrupted a little, but it was fun.)
(Ranka-chan and I made plans to hang out today...)

(I haven't planned anything, though.
Where should we go...)

Sorry to keep you waiting!
\p-chan!

Not at all, you're early.
So, where should we go today?
Isn't there anywhere you want to go, Ranka-chan?
I see. But we don't have to pick just one, right?
What kind of movies do you like, Ranka-chan?

I'll watch anything...
But right now I'm in the mood for an action movie!

Then there's a good one showing.
If I remember right, it's a revival screening
of "Shao Pai Long". Shall we go see it?
rows.notes: Female. Title as glossary 'Shao Pai Long' (written with the variant dragon kanji here).

rows.en: Yaaay!

Huh?! Ranka-chan!
What's gotten into you?! Linking arms
all of a sudden...
Ehehe~!

I kind of wish I'd had a big sister
instead of a big brother.
rows.notes: Ranka, female (generic kinship, not Big Bro as a name).

rows.en: Oh, come on~

Just kidding.
Big Bro would get mad at me if I said that.
Hehe, then let's go see the movie!
Haah~, that was fun~

Of course!
Well then, shall we head home?
(Yep, I really enjoyed my day off with Ranka-chan!)
(Ranka and I are going out today, but...)

Hey, Ranka,
is there anywhere you want to go?
There's a movie I want to see...
Alright, let's see a movie.
Huh, are you sure?
I was fine with anything, so.

That's no good~
You've got to take the lead more with a girl.
Yes, you do!
rows.notes: Ranka, both genders; answers 'You think so?'.

rows.en: That movie was fun, huh.
I could watch it again and again~
Well then, let's go get something to eat somewhere.

(The movie was fun, the food was good...
That was a perfect change of pace!)
(Ranka-chan and I are going out today, but...)

Hey, Ranka-chan,
is there anywhere you want to go?
I was fine with anything, so.

That's no good~
You've got to take the lead more yourself.

uncertain: c12878: the film title is written with the variant kanji of Shao Pai Long; used the glossary title 'Shao Pai Long' in double quotes.
c12855/c12856: Michel's minaoshita ('you went up in my estimation', implying he approves of the player dating Ranka) rendered 'I'm impressed' / 'Impressed by what?'.
